 #ifdef DEBUG_ENABLED
-	if (p_binary_op->variant_op == Variant::OP_DIVIDE && left_type.builtin_type == Variant::INT && right_type.builtin_type == Variant::INT) {
+	if (p_binary_op->variant_op == Variant::OP_DIVIDE &&

+					left_type.builtin_type == Variant::VECTOR3I ||
+					left_type.builtin_type == Variant::VECTOR4I) &&
+			(right_type.builtin_type == Variant::INT ||
+					right_type.builtin_type == Variant::VECTOR2I ||

body: This adds integer division warning even for invalid divisions (like `Vector2i / Vector3i`) which already error out about invalid division operands. It should warn only for valid divisions. ```suggestion (right_type.builtin_type == Variant::INT || right_type.builtin_type == left_type.builtin_type) { ```
